ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) safe-boot ransomware pre-stage: bcdedit safeboot + recovery inhibition chain
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin's signature pre-encryption chain — reconfiguring the boot manager to enter Safe Mode (where EDR drivers don't load) and simultaneously destroying shadow copies / backup catalogs. Qilin's Rust/Go binaries explicitly support `--safe-mode` / `safeboot` flags that drive this exact sequence before detonation.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as binaries values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents dc(Processes.process_name) as binary_variety from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("bcdedit.exe","vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bootstatuspolicy.exe") AND (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*minimal*" OR Processes.process="*network*" OR Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*deletecatalog-quiet*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name span=30m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where binary_variety >= 2 AND user!="SYSTEM" AND NOT match(user,"\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Qilin (Agenda) safe-boot + recovery-inhibit chain — 30m correlation window
let Window = 30m;
let Recovery = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
         or (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","delete catalog","shadowcopy delete"))
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy delete")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service");
Recovery
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            BinariesUsed = make_set(FileName, 10),
            BinaryVariety = dcount(FileName),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| where BinaryVariety >= 2          // bcdedit + vssadmin (or wbadmin) together = Qilin chain, not a sysadmin one-off
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Qilin (Agenda) safe-boot + recovery-inhibit chain — Sentinel 4688 path
let Window = 30m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend BinName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where (BinName == "bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("safeboot","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
     or (BinName == "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","delete catalog","shadowcopy delete"))
     or (BinName == "wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete")
     or (BinName == "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy delete")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            BinariesUsed  = make_set(BinName, 10),
            BinaryVariety = dcount(BinName),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
            Parents    = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| where BinaryVariety >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin Safe-Boot + Recovery Inhibition Chain
id: 7c3a5e21-9b1a-4f3e-b6c1-9e0f9d8b7c61
status: experimental
description: Detects the Qilin (Agenda) ransomware pre-encryption chain — reconfiguring boot manager to Safe Mode while deleting shadow copies / backup catalogs.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2024/06/27/qilin-ransomware-safe-mode/
author: SOC detection engineering
date: 2026/06/03
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  bcdedit_safeboot:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'safeboot'
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
  vssadmin_delete:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'delete shadows'
      - 'delete catalog'
      - 'shadowcopy delete'
  wbadmin_delete:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' delete '
  wmic_shadow:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'shadowcopy delete'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (bcdedit_safeboot or vssadmin_delete or wbadmin_delete or wmic_shadow) and not filter_machine_acct
falsepositives:
  - Disaster-recovery operator runbooks (rare, should be allowlisted by host/account)
  - Backup software cleanup jobs running as service accounts
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEdit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SafeBoot* OR *"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"*)) OR (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSadmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"delete catalog"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"*)) OR (@Image:(*\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBadmin.exe OR *\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*"shadowcopy delete"*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(safeboot|recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)/i)

  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i)
| NOT (UserName=/\$$/)
| BinName := regex("\\\\(?<n>[^\\\\]+)$", field=ImageFileName, strict=false) | BinName := n

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) backup/security service kill-list via net/sc/taskkill prior to encryption
ucs.description: Qilin affiliates run a documented, hard-coded enumeration of Veeam, MSSQL, Acronis, SQL Server, Defender, and Sophos services using `net stop`/`sc stop`/`taskkill` (often via a `.bat` dropped to ADMIN$ or pushed by GPO/PsExec) immediately before ransomware deployment. This hunts the per-host burst of stop-actions against Qilin's known target service list.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe") AND (Processes.process="*stop*" OR Processes.process="*delete*" OR Processes.process="*/f*" OR Processes.process="*/im*") AND (Processes.process="*veeam*" OR Processes.process="*mssql*" OR Processes.process="*sqlserver*" OR Processes.process="*sqlwriter*" OR Processes.process="*sqlbrowser*" OR Processes.process="*acronis*" OR Processes.process="*backup*" OR Processes.process="*sophos*" OR Processes.process="*sense*" OR Processes.process="*windefend*" OR Processes.process="*mpssvc*" OR Processes.process="*wdnissvc*" OR Processes.process="*securityhealth*" OR Processes.process="*memtas*" OR Processes.process="*svc$*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval stop_count=mvcount(cmdlines) | where stop_count >= 5 AND user!="SYSTEM" AND NOT match(user,"\$$") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Qilin (Agenda) backup/AV service kill-list — burst of stops on the Qilin target list in 10m
let TargetServices = dynamic(["veeam","mssql","sqlserver","sqlwriter","sqlbrowser","acronis","backup","sophos","sense","windefend","mpssvc","wdnissvc","securityhealth","memtas","vss","sqltelemetry","msdtsserver","ccsf","avp","ekrn","sentinelagent"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where (FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "stop")
     or (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop","delete","config"))
     or (FileName =~ "taskkill.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/f","/im"))
     or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Stop-Service","Set-Service"))
| extend cmdLower = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| where cmdLower has_any (TargetServices)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize StopCount = count(),
            DistinctTargets = dcount(extract(@"(?i)(veeam|mssql|sqlserver|sqlwriter|sqlbrowser|acronis|backup|sophos|sense|windefend|mpssvc|wdnissvc|securityhealth|memtas|vss|avp|ekrn|sentinelagent)", 1, cmdLower)),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 15),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            ParentCmds = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine, 5)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where DistinctTargets >= 3 and StopCount >= 5     // 3+ distinct Qilin-target service families AND 5+ stop actions in 10m
| order by LastSeen desc
